svg.title: EvoSprig agent application architecture
svg.desc: Python SDK and visual canvas produce AgentSpec. The durable runtime runs workflows with models, tools and memory, and exports versioned Python, HTTP and container applications. ComfyUI workflow JSON can be imported, edited and exported. Execution feedback enters evaluation on user tasks. Evolution proposes candidates; release checks and manual adoption select the version enabled in the runtime. Criteria stay fixed and search budgets are bounded.

g.aria-label: ComfyUI workflow JSON import and export
